title: Bread for the Watch
summary: Maren sends a basket of buns up the east road every week. This week her legs have opinions about it.

stages.text: Take Maren's basket to Lom Perrin, the bridgewarden at the end of the east road.
stages.hint: Follow the east road past the watchtower and the relay to the bridge barrier.

stages.text: Lom sent something back with you. Maren will want to know he ate.

completion_text: Lom has his buns. Maren pretended not to care how he was.
